faq_heading: Homes near James Hill Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the James Hill Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the James Hill Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names James Hill Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near James Hill Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 92 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,469,250, townhomes $780,000, condos $543,750. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near James Hill Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of James Hill Elementary the median was 16 days on the market, closing at 98.1% of the list price, with 4% of sales above the list price for the 92 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to James Hill Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Langley Fundamental Elementary (1.3 km north-west), Credo Christian Schools (1.4 km north-west) and Murrayville Academy (1.5 km north-west).

James Hill Elementary is an elementary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 22144 Old Yale Rd. It teaches grades K to 5.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name James Hill Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the James Hill Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names James Hill Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of James Hill Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 92 homes sold within 1 km of James Hill Elementary: 34 houses, 37 townhomes and 20 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $780,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of James Hill Elementary

12 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of James Hill Elementary in a straight line (5 secondary, 4 elementary, 3 other; 3 independent). The closest is Langley Fundamental Elementary, 1.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is Brookswood Secondary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Choices Program (2.6 km); the nearest independent school is Credo Christian Schools (1.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Brookswood Secondary (3.0 km). Other elementary schools close by: Langley Fundamental Elementary (1.3 km north-west), Murrayville Academy (1.5 km north-west), Peterson Road Elementary (2.6 km east), Uplands Elementary (2.9 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Langley Fundamental Elementary, 1.3 km north-west of James Hill Elementary.
